Memory from a session on Friday, 20 January 2023, at about 4:04 pm, between Jon and Gina, who appear to be friends who catch up in person and share a love of dance.

Jon lost his job as a banker on 19 January 2023, the day before this session. He told Gina he plans to start his own business, a dance studio. Gina said she also lost her job this month, in January 2023, at DoorDash, which is her most recent job before this session. Neither of them said what they plan to do next for income, and Gina did not mention a new job during this session.

Jon's motivation for the studio is his long-standing passion for dance, which he has loved since childhood and describes as both his passion and his escape. He wants to share the joy dance gives him by teaching others. He said he loves all dance styles but names contemporary as his favorite because it is expressive and powerful. Gina also finds dance to be her main form of stress relief and said contemporary is her favorite too, describing it as expressive and graceful and something that really speaks to her. The two agreed that dance is central to both of their lives.

Jon said his dance crew took first place at a local competition in 2022, "last year" from the perspective of January 2023. He shared a photo of a man in a suit performing a dance, taken at that competition, and said being on that stage was amazing and that he wants to spread that intensity to other people. Gina said she used to compete in several dance competitions and shows. Her favorite memory is her team winning first place at a regional competition when she was fifteen. She shared a photo of two people standing next to each other, and said the team performed a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom," which was emotional and powerful. Her age now is not stated in this session.

Jon and Gina agreed to plan a dance session together. Jon invited Gina to see his moves "next Fri," and Gina replied that next Friday works and said "let's boogie." Taken relative to 20 January 2023, the most likely date is Friday, 27 January 2023, though the message does not state the date outright. Jon also said he was excited and that this would be great. Gina also suggested they explore some new dance moves and take a dance class together, which Jon enthusiastically endorsed.

Jon shared a photo of a room with a view of the ocean and a few yoga mats, and described it as his ideal dance studio by the water. He said he hopes to find a place like this that will inspire him and his dancers. Gina shared a photo of a large open porch with a fireplace and a view of the water and commented on the view. The studio is still a plan, and no location has been secured yet. Gina asked how Jon would balance a business and a new space with dance. His reply was only that he hopes to find a place like the one pictured. The studio's location, funding, and opening date are not yet known.

Jon currently rehearses with a small group of dancers after work, though he has now lost his banking job, so "after work" refers to the period before he was let go. The group performs all kinds of dance, from contemporary to hip-hop. Jon said they have several projects in the works. He is finishing choreography for a performance at a nearby festival next month, which means February 2023. He shared a photo of a group of dancers in white dresses on a stage and said they are the ones performing at the festival. He said they have been practicing hard and will impress with their grace and skill. Gina said they look graceful and great and she cannot wait to see them at the festival. Jon said he is glad to be part of it.
